jobs.title: Principal Consultant* - Project Manager Credit and Capital Management
Senior MarTech Product Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Role summary

You own the marketing-technology layer behind Taxfix's growth: the conversion signals that tell ad networks who converted, the customer data that powers CRM, the consent flows that decide what we may share and with whom, and the referral program, one of the growth mechanics the team owns end to end. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. You set direction for a small engineering team (a tech lead plus 3–4 engineers, two-week sprints) that supports four products across three markets, with Paid Acquisition, CRM, Brand and Creative as internal customers. A typical week mixes debugging a missing ad-network event, scoping a referral reward, settling a data-sharing question with Legal, and explaining trade-offs to leadership. All work, including across markets, happens in English; German is not required.

What you'll do

  • Own conversion-signal engineering for paid acquisition: client-side and server-to-server events into Singular, Firebase/GA4, Google Ads and TikTok, including synthetic events, revenue values and predicted-LTV signals.

  • Run the referral program as a product: reward mechanics, eligibility and fraud rules, voucher infrastructure (Voucherify), the in-app voucher wallet, entry points, and the experiments that tune them.

  • Grow push and marketing-consent opt-in through permission primers, iOS/Android OS permission flows and notification preferences.

  • Keep CRM data trustworthy: Braze attributes and events, Snowflake-to-Braze syncs, event-loss monitoring, and moving legacy messaging (SendGrid, Firebase) onto Braze.

  • Turn consent and privacy requirements into product behaviour, and work with Legal on what data can go to which partner.

  • Adapt tracking, CRM attributes and attribution to company launches, such as new subscription pricing tiers, without breaking downstream campaigns or reporting.

  • Turn stakeholder requests, support escalations and spike findings into tickets engineers can start on, and decide what goes into the sprint.

  • Weigh roadmap work against platform upkeep: pipeline migrations, security fixes, end-of-life SDKs.

  • Design A/B tests (Eppo) and read the results for marketing and consent opt-s, and referral changes.

  • Report progress, risks and trade-offs in writing to marketing leadership, including VP and C-level.

Must-have skills and experience

  • Several years as a product manager owning martech, growth infrastructure or data products, setting your own roadmap with senior stakeholders.

  • Hands-on mobile and web attribution: an MMP (Singular or comparable), server-to-server events, and ad-network conversion setups (Google Ads, TikTok).

  • Event-tracking depth: you can define an event schema, write a tracking spec, and trace a missing or duplicated event through Segment, Google Tag Manager and the receiving platform.

  • CRM data platforms, ideally Braze: custom attributes, event-triggered segmentation, data ingestion and sync quality.

  • Working knowledge of EU consent and privacy: GDPR, consent mode, iOS App Tracking Transparency, and how push permissions behave on iOS and Android.

  • Experimentation: framing hypotheses, choosing and configuring metrics, judging when a result is real.

  • Precise writing: specs that engineers (and AI coding agents) can start on without a meeting, and concise updates and decision memos for leadership.

  • Enough technical fluency to work through trade-offs with engineers across mobile apps (React Native), backend services and data pipelines, and to triage production incidents.

Nice to have

  • Performance marketing experience with the main app and web acquisition channels (e.g. Google Ads, TikTok).

  • Referral, loyalty or voucher programs; Voucherify specifically.

  • Predicted-LTV or value-based bidding signals (e.g. Churney).

  • Deep linking and deferred deep linking across ad networks.

  • AI-driven CRM orchestration (Aampe) or creative asset tooling (Frontify, AI creative tagging).

  • Building AI agents or automation for product and engineering workflows.

  • Querying data yourself in SQL (Snowflake), and familiarity with dbt and Airflow.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

jobs.title: AI Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Us
Creative Clicks is a leading global marketing agency with offices worldwide and 200+ professionals. Since 2009, we’ve been empowering brands, publishers, and marketers to attract and engage customers at scale with cutting-edge technology and creativity. We live by our Triple E philosophy — Energetic, Entrepreneurial, Experts — and our motto: One team. One dream.

The Role
We’re looking for an AI Product Owner to lead the way in turning ideas into impactful AI solutions. In this role, you’ll be the bridge between business needs, user experience, and technical execution. From ideation to delivery, you’ll own the AI product roadmap, making sure every product we launch creates measurable value, drives innovation, and is grounded in real-world usability.

You’ll work hand in hand with engineers, data scientists, marketers, and commercial teams to identify opportunities, prioritize features, and bring innovative AI products to life.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the AI product vision and roadmap — set priorities, milestones, and adapt as business goals and market needs evolve.

  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.

  • Collaborate with engineers and data scientists to deliver AI-driven solutions that enhance efficiency, engagement, and outcomes.

  • Stay ahead of AI and machine learning trends to ensure Creative Clicks is always leading innovation.

  • Champion AI adoption across the company, driving awareness and practical application.

  • Define and track KPIs to measure product success and business impact.

  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and communication across teams.

  • Ensure compliance with data privacy, ethical AI standards, and responsible usage.


What We’re Looking For
You thrive where speed meets precision. You think in solutions, not problems, and feel at home in both strategy discussions and reviewing technical deliverables.

Must-haves:

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role (ideally with AI, data, or SaaS products).

  • Solid understanding of AI/ML concepts and ability to translate them into business value (no coding required, but you speak the language).

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience working in agile environments with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong ability to prioritize and adapt quickly in a fast-paced setting.

  • Analytical mindset with focus on measurable results.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Background in performance marketing, martech, or adtech.

  • Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools.

  • Knowledge of ethical AI frameworks and regulations.

What Makes You Successful Here
At Creative Clicks, our top performers:

  • Take initiative and ownership.

  • Focus on solutions, not obstacles.

  • Stay grounded, even under pressure.

  • Collaborate closely with their teams.

  • Continuously deepen their expertise to inspire others.

What We Offer

  • A highly dynamic and fast-growing working environment.

  • An international company with more than 25 nationalities.

  • Competitive salary and fully paid commuting expenses.

  • 25 days of annual leave (plus the option to buy 10 more) with a healthy work-life balance and hybrid work setup.

  • A place to learn, discover, and develop yourself.

  • Warm daily lunch in the office.

  • A fun, ambitious, and young team of colleagues.

  • A recently renovated, beautiful office just 2 minutes from Leidseplein in Amsterdam.

Creative Clicks is proud to be a diverse and equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Selection decisions are solely based on job-related factors.

Apply Now
Ready to own AI products that set the trend and push innovation forward? Apply now and join us at Creative Clicks.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner - Social Connection & Loyalty
jobs.description:
Our Team

We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel.

                                                                                                

We’re on the search for…

At Interrail, we help people experience Europe by train. We are looking for a PO to make that experience more connected, rewarding, and transformative. You will lead the strategy and roadmap for products that bring travellers together, recognise their journeys, and give them more reasons to return to Interrail and make them feel a sense of belonging. 

 

From social connection, community, to loyalty, referrals, and gamification, you will create experiences that turn a great trip into a lasting relationship with our brand. Some of these experiences will also support informal learning, intercultural exchange and personal development through travel.

 

You will work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Lifecycle Marketing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams to build products that customers genuinely value and that strengthen engagement, retention, advocacy, and lifetime value.  

The role exists to solve one fundamental challenge: how do we create meaningful reasons for travellers to remain engaged with Interrail between journeys, and return not only to travel again, but to participate, contribute and advocate for the brand?

 

What you’ll be doing

  •  Define and deliver the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for community, loyalty, referrals, and gamification. 

  • Own the digital loyalty experience and economics. 

  • Design products that enable meaningful interactions and real-world connections between travellers, while maintaining a safe, respectful and inclusive environment.  

  • Develop product experiences that encourage cultural exchange, curiosity and informal learning through social interaction.  

  • Work with Institutional Initiatives to translate relevant programme objectives into engaging traveller experiences, where these align with the broader Social Connection & Loyalty product strategy. 

  • Build experiences that help travellers connect, share, contribute, and discover useful travel content. 

  • Create loyalty, recognition, and referral journeys that encourage advocacy and repeat travel. 

  • Work with Design, CX, and Engineering to deliver simple, scalable web and mobile experiences. 

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to connect campaigns with relevant in-product journeys. 

  • Use customer insight, behavioural data, AI, and experimentation (A/B testing) to identify opportunities and personalise experiences. 

  • Work with Customer Support and relevant partners to ensure community experiences are safe, trustworthy, and useful. 

  • Define and track success metrics across Traveller Participation Rate, engagement, retention, repeat purchase, referrals, loyalty participation, and customer lifetime value. 

 

What we’re looking for

It's already a possible match when you share the same mindset as us, being forward-thinking, results-driven, caring and embracing diversity.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with experience building and scaling B2C digital products across web and mobile.

  • A track record of building products that improve engagement, retention, loyalty, community participation, or growth. 

  • Demonstrated experience building social, community-driven or interaction-led digital products, with a strong understanding of how to create meaningful interactions between users. 

  • Experience owning a product area from strategy and discovery through delivery, scaling, and optimization. 

  • Experience designing for trust, safety, inclusion and healthy community participation, particularly where digital experiences facilitate interaction between people who do not already know one another. 

  • Strong qualitative user research and behavioral insight skills, with the ability to understand why people connect, participate and contribute, not only what they click or use. 

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer insight into simple, valuable experiences. 

  • Confidence using data, experimentation, and product metrics to make decisions and measure incremental impact. 

  • Experience working closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other business stakeholders. 

  • A thoughtful approach to customer trust, privacy, safety, and responsible engagement design. 

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, international environment. 

 

Nice to have:

  • Experience translating institutional, educational or social-impact objectives into compelling consumer-facing digital experiences.

  • An interest in travel, rail, and the ways people discover and share experiences.

  • Experience with user-generated content, personalisation, CRM platforms, or notification systems.

 

Our offer

  • We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, enhancing teamwork and connection.

  • A complimentary NS train card to travel across the Netherlands for work and leisure.

  • An annual free Interrail/Eurail travel pass for you and a companion, so you can explore Europe and share the same experiences as our customers.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp for lifestyle & well-being recommendations.

  • Support for your well-being through a personal allowance of €1500.

  • We provide a training allowance of €4000 to support learning opportunities relevant to your role.

  • Variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe to experience our product first-hand.

  • 20 working days per year from abroad.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days, and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 61, Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% allowance): €7000 - 8000 (full-time) based on experience.

 

Curious to apply?

Apply directly via our website (https://www.interrail.com/en/careers).

 

  • We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Eurail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills.

 

If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview. For you, this is a chance to understand if Eurail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring.

 

To support fair and unbiased hiring, we use a blind recruitment process in the early stages. Personal details such as your name, date of birth, photo, contact information, social media links, gender, and nationality are hidden, allowing us to focus on your skills, experience, and potential.

In the meantime…

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help — just drop us a note at

 

While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at  https://www.interrail.com/en.

  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Principal Consultant* – Project Manager Core Banking
Principal Consultant* - Business Analyst / Project Manager Payments
Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.

 
 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.

  • Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.

  • Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.

  • Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.

  • For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.

  • Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.

  • Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.

 

What is expected of you

  • Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.

  • A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.

  • The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.

  • Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.

  • Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.

  • We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.

Additional experience we value:

  • Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).

  • Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).

  • Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).

  • A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

jobs.title: Bid & Project Manager – EU & NATO (H/F)
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

NATO agencies & EU programs are investing in counter-drone capability now, and Alta Ares answers a fast-growing flow of their tenders and calls for proposals. As Bid & Project Manager in our EU, NATO & Eastern Flank team, you turn each opportunity into a compliant offer, then into a project delivered on time. Your sales director owns the customer relationship and the commercial strategy; you own the offer and its delivery.

This is not a one-programme job. You will run several bids and projects at once: a NATO bid, an EU grant proposal, and an RFI can land in the same week, and none of them can slip.

This is a demanding, high-ownership role. Deadlines do not move, the stakes are real, and the team will rely on you to hold the line. We are looking for someone who wants that responsibility.

Bid Management - from first read to submission

  • Screen and qualify opportunities with your sales director; prepare bid/no-bid decisions with risks, resources, and price on the table

  • Break each tender down (NATO IFB or RFQ, EU call, RFP for a Nation through EU-NATO platforms such as NSPA or SAFE joint procurement) into a compliance matrix, a bid plan and clear owners

  • Write and assemble the management, technical and compliance volumes with Engineering, Product, Finance and Legal

  • Organise the review gates and prepare the final price review with Finance; submit complete, compliant and on time, every time

  • Run the clarification rounds and support your sales director in negotiations through to contract signature

NATO & EU Procurement - the rules of the game

  • Master NSPA and NCIA procedures: Source File registration, declarations of eligibility, notifications of intent, IFBs and RFQs, basic ordering agreements and framework contracts

  • Run EU grant proposals (European Defence Fund, EDIP): Funding & Tenders portal, consortium building, Part A and Part B, lump-sum budgets

  • Track national procurement rules and partners on the Eastern Flank through EU-NATO (Poland, Romania, the Baltic States…), e.g. via NSPA or SAFE joint procurement

  • Build and maintain the bid library: company documents, CVs, past performance, standard answers, templates

Project Delivery - from award to acceptance

  • Turn each award into a project: kick-off, plan, milestones, risks, budget and change control

  • Coordinate engineering, production, demo and logistics teams, and partners, to deliver what we promised when we promised it

  • Own customer reporting, deliverables and acceptance (FAT/SAT), with the documentation trail for invoicing and audits

  • Run several projects in parallel, each at a different stage

Process & Reporting

  • Set the bid and project rhythm for the team: calendar, gates, templates, dashboards

  • Review the status of every live bid and project weekly with your sales director: deadlines, compliance, risks, resources needed

  • Run lessons learned after every bid, won or lost

Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years in bid, proposal or project management in defence, aerospace or security

  • Proven record of compliant, on-time submissions to NATO agencies, EU programmes or European ministries of defence, several of them in parallel

  • At least one defence contract delivered from award to acceptance

  • Scale-up or lean-team experience is a significant advantage; prime experience is welcome if you want more breadth and speed

Skills & Qualities

  • Rigorous and precise compliance is binary; in defence, the margin for error is zero

  • Built for parallel work you run several bids and projects at once, prioritise hard and never drop the ball

  • Committed you own the outcome, not just your part of it; submission peaks are part of the job and you plan for them

  • Calm under pressure fixed deadlines, late amendments and competing requests do not throw you

  • A clear writer structured, scoreable English; you turn engineering input into compliant answers

  • A leader without authority you get engineers, Finance, Legal and partners to deliver on time

  • Technically curious you understand how sensors, effectors, C2 and AI fit together, or you learn it fast

  • Discreet and trustworthy you handle sensitive commercial and defence information as a matter of course

  • Mission-driven you care about European security, not just the job title

Nice to Have

  • APMP, Shipley, PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA certification

  • Experience on a European Defence Fund or EDIP consortium, or with NSPA/NCIA procurement

  • A background in a NATO agency, the EDA or a ministry of defence, or military service (officer or NCO)

  • Knowledge of C-UAS, air defence, ISR or drones

  • Export-control experience (French export licensing, EU dual-use rules)

Security

  • This position will require applying for a NATO personnel security clearance; it is therefore open to nationals of EU Member States that are also NATO members, and the hire is subject to the clearance procedure

Languages

  • Professional English, written and spoken (C1) is mandatory

  • French is a strong plus

  • Polish, Romanian, Lithuanian or Ukrainian is a plus

Travel

  • Regular travel to NATO agencies (Brussels, Luxembourg, The Hague), EU institutions, and to demos and acceptance tests across Europe

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description:
About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position

We're looking for a proactive and highly organized Technical Project Manager to lead customer implementations across Constructor's product suite. You will lead onboardings for new customers as well as implementations of additional products for existing customers, owning each engagement from kickoff through activation. You will own the plan, the timeline, and the outcome, and you drive the people delivering it through a matrixed reporting structure. As we build toward an automation-first operating model, you will help standardize how implementations are run and increasingly act as a portfolio strategist, managing exceptions while repeatable, AI-assisted processes carry the routine work.

You will:

• Lead multiple implementations end to end, both new-customer onboardings and additional-product rollouts for existing customers, from kickoff through integration, testing, and activation.

• Take accountability for the outcome of every implementation, coordinating Constructor resources, customer resources, and partners, against a single shared plan.

• Run kickoffs, set milestones, track dependencies, and maintain a clear, shared view of status for internal stakeholders and the customer.

• Serve as the customer's primary point of contact through activation, setting expectations and communicating progress, risks, and changes in scope.

• Identify risks and blockers early, escalate effectively, and keep implementations moving toward on-time, predictable delivery.

• Ensure clean handoffs into implementation from Sales and out of implementation to Customer Success and Support.

• Maintain implementation plans and reporting in our systems of record so schedule, duration, and status roll up cleanly across your portfolio.

• Help build the repeatable processes, templates, and standards that let the function scale, and partner on the automation-first model as it matures.

Role Responsibilities: Technical Project Management

• Own the Outcome: Be accountable for the success of each implementation from kickoff to activation, whether the work is delivered by Constructor, the customer, or a partner, standing behind on-time, predictable go-live for both new customers and existing-customer product rollouts.

• Drive Every Contributor: Coordinate Constructor technical resources, customer resources, and partners against one plan, holding each accountable to their commitments through influence rather than authority.

• Lead the Customer Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact through activation, running a clear communication rhythm and building customer confidence from kickoff to handoff.

• Manage Handoffs & Risk: Ensure accurate handoffs from Sales into implementation and from implementation into Customer Success and Support, surfacing risk early and keeping delivery on track wherever the risk sits.

• Build Scalable Process: Standardize how implementations are run at Constructor, maintain accurate tracking and reporting, and help advance the automation-first operating model as the function grows.

Requirements

You Have

• At least 3 years of technical project management or onboarding project management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment.

• A track record of owning delivery outcomes end to end and holding cross-functional contributors accountable through influence rather than direct authority.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations in parallel without losing the thread.

• Customer-facing confidence: you can lead a kickoff, manage expectations, and keep stakeholders aligned through go-live.

• Proven ability to prioritize effectively, manage competing demands, and maintain clarity under ambiguity.

Nice to Have

• Technical fluency sufficient to direct integration specialists and translate between technical and business stakeholders.

• Exposure to ecommerce, product discovery, LLMs and familiarity with concepts like catalog data feeds, integrations and APIs.

• Experience coordinating implementations that span internal teams, customer resources, and third-party partners.

Benefits

🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

💰 A competitive compensation package including stock options

🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

🏥 Company sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee)

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

Product Owner (spéc. Tableau de bord)
jobs.description:
Contexte :

Nous recherchons, pour notre client, un grand groupe télécom, un Product Owner spécialisé en tableaux de bord pour piloter le run et les évolutions de notre patrimoine de dataviz, au service des équipes construction.

Ce Product Owner garantit que les utilisateurs disposent de tableaux de bord fiables, disponibles et utiles sur l'ensemble de leurs activités : construction, MCO (maintien en conditions opérationnelles) et SAV.

Vous serez le point de contact privilégié des utilisateurs pour leurs besoins de data visualisation. Vous travaillerez à partir des données déjà présentes dans GCP ou HDF, et produirez les tableaux de bord dans Power BI On Cloud, dans le respect de la charte graphique.

Vous représenterez également notre collectif et nos façons de travailler auprès de l'équipe DATA IA, et relaierez ses préconisations sur Power BI et Looker Studio.

Responsabilités clés

Votre mission centrale : assurer le run du patrimoine de tableaux de bord (Power BI On Cloud ou Google Looker Studio) et accompagner les salariés sur leurs besoins de data visualisation.

  1. Piloter le développement des tableaux de bord

o Cadrer et spécifier les besoins avec les utilisateurs.

o Découper les besoins en user stories et rédiger leurs critères d'acceptation.

o Suivre la réalisation avec l'équipe de développement nearshore, du backlog jusqu'à la mise en production.

  1. Maintenir le patrimoine existant

o Garantir la disponibilité et le bon fonctionnement des tableaux de bord de notre espace de travail Power BI.

o Optimiser leur coût de fonctionnement.

o Veiller au respect de la charte graphique.

  1. Accompagner les utilisateurs

o Traiter les demandes d'ajout, de correction ou de suppression de fonctionnalités des salariés.

o Appuyer l'équipe PDATA sur ses sujets dataviz en cours, notamment le tableau de bord performance.

  1. Animer le cadre agile

o Gérer et prioriser le backlog JIRA Dataviz (WSJF ou équivalent).

o Faciliter les cérémonies : lancement de sprint, points d'équipe, revues et rétrospectives.

  1. Être force de proposition auprès de DATA IA

o Représenter notre collectif et nos façons de travailler.

o Relayer les préconisations sur les outils Power BI et Looker Studio.

Résultats attendus :

Les livrables sont remis en français, après chaque bilan de sprint.

· Formulaire JIRA Dataviz mis en œuvre.

· Backlog JIRA Dataviz rédigé et ordonnancé.

· Comptes rendus des cérémonies agiles (lancement de sprint, réunions, rétrospectives).

· Tableaux de bord dans Power BI On Cloud ou Looker Studio livrés sans anomalie.

· Indicateurs de pilotage de l'activité Dataviz, mesurant le type de demande, l'entité du demandeur, la durée de traitement de chaque carte JIRA, du backlog jusqu'à l'implémentation et la satisfaction des utilisateurs, via un bilan systématique.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes un profil hybride, à l'aise aussi bien avec la donnée qu'avec l'animation d'équipe et la relation utilisateur.

· Background technique Data : vous comprenez les modèles de données, les requêtes et le fonctionnement d'un tableau de bord de bout en bout.

· Au moins 3 ans d'expérience comme Product Owner ou chef de projet, très à l'aise avec l'agilité (Scrum, SAFe).

· Expérience du pilotage d'un delivery nearshore : priorisation, suivi des engagements, recette.

· Sens du service et disponibilité auprès des utilisateurs métier.

· Capacité à formaliser : spécifications, user stories, comptes rendus et indicateurs de suivi.

· Force de proposition, capable de porter la voix de l'équipe auprès d'interlocuteurs transverses comme DATA IA.

Rythme : Présentiel 3 jours/semaine + télétravail

Rémunération : Package 60-75k€ selon profil

Contrat : CDI

Rattachement : COO

L'entreprise

Rejoignez une entreprise innovante spécialisée dans les solutions SaaS B2B de mobilité intelligente, en forte croissance, basée à Rennes et composée d'une trentaine de collaborateurs. PYSAE développe un logiciel pour rendre le transport public plus performant et attractif. Nous accompagnons plus de 100 clients, dont des opérateurs majeurs comme Transdev, Keolis ou la RATP, et équipons plus de 10 000 bus, en France métropolitaine, DOM-TOM, Italie et Arabie Saoudite.

Votre Mission

Vous prenez la tête de l'équipe technique de PYSAE : sept personnes, développeurs de différentes spécialités et profil DevOps, mêlant collaborateurs en CDI et prestataires. Votre rôle est de maintenir une équipe performante, force de proposition, autonome et alignée sur les ambitions Produit de l'entreprise, tout en structurant la collaboration avec les autres équipes de l’entreprise.

Notre façon de développer est en pleine transformation : l'IA générative a fait changer d’échelle la productivité de l'équipe. Votre mission est d'accompagner cette dynamique : aider l'équipe à continuer de progresser, en exploiter pleinement les gains de cette technologie, et construire les process qui permettent d'aller vite sans perdre la maîtrise ni la connaissance de notre système. C'est la condition pour soutenir la stratégie Produit ambitieuse de PYSAE.

Ce poste est avant tout un poste de management, de pilotage mais aussi de contact client et partenaires : l’IA générative fait prendre de la hauteur sur les sujets à chaque contributeur, et il est donc essentiel que le manager de l’équipe soit au contact du terrain. Il s'adresse à quelqu'un qui trouve son énergie dans le fait de faire réussir une équipe et de livrer des projets qui comptent pour des clients exigeants. Une expertise technique est un vrai atout pour dialoguer d'égal à égal avec l'équipe, mais l'enjeu n'est pas de coder ni d'être le meilleur expert technique de la pièce.

Vos Responsabilités

Management de l'équipe technique

  • Encadrer, animer et faire grandir une équipe de 7 personnes, mêlant CDI et prestataires

  • Assurer le suivi individuel de chacun : objectifs, montée en compétences, feedback, recrutement

  • Créer un cadre de travail où l'équipe est autonome, responsabilisée et motivée, dans un contexte de forte évolution des pratiques

  • Rendre compte au COO avec le bon niveau de détail, à la bonne fréquence

IA générative & process d'ingénierie

  • Accompagner l'équipe dans l'usage de l'IA générative au quotidien et en capitaliser les gains de productivité

  • Construire et faire évoluer les process de développement adaptés à ces nouveaux modes de travail (revues, qualité, documentation, livraison)

  • Garantir que l'équipe garde la maîtrise et la connaissance de notre système, malgré l'accélération permise par l'IA

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et encourager l'expérimentation raisonnée

Gestion de projets techniques

  • Piloter les projets techniques de bout en bout : cadrage, planification, suivi, gestion des risques, livraison

  • Arbitrer les priorités techniques et monitorer la charge de l'équipe en lien avec les équipes Produit et Opérations

  • Assurer la communication sur l'avancement auprès des parties prenantes internes et externes

Proximité client & connaissance du domaine

  • Aller à la rencontre des clients et des utilisateurs pour comprendre leurs usages et leurs attentes

  • Construire une connaissance du domaine du transport public, en complément de celle de l'équipe Produit

  • Faire le lien entre les besoins terrain et les choix techniques, en apportant le point de vue de l'ingénierie

  • Contribuer aux échanges techniques avec les clients et partenaires lorsque nécessaire

Collaboration transverse

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les managers Produit et Opérations (qui reportent comme vous au COO) pour la priorisation, les remontées terrain et les process inter-équipes

  • Contribuer à la stratégie produit en éclairant la faisabilité, les coûts et les risques techniques

Votre Profil

  • 7 à 12 ans d'expérience, dont une expérience significative de management d'équipes techniques, idéalement au sein d'un éditeur de logiciels

  • Capacité à manager des profils techniques variés, dont des prestataires, et à fédérer une équipe mixte

  • Expérience confirmée de la gestion de projets techniques (cadrage, pilotage, livraison)

  • Réelle proximité avec les clients et goût pour comprendre le domaine métier, avec une capacité à prendre du recul

  • Bonne culture technique permettant de dialoguer avec les développeurs et de challenger leurs choix ; une expertise technique est un plus

  • Réel intérêt pour l'IA générative et son impact sur les métiers de l'ingénierie ; une expérience concrète d'accompagnement d'équipes sur ce sujet est un gros plus

  • Autonome et fiable : on doit pouvoir vous faire confiance sur votre périmètre, vous savez quand, comment et à qui rendre compte

  • Polyvalent(e) et adaptable : vous savez faire évoluer vos priorités dans une structure agile où les rôles ne sont pas figés

  • Excellent sens de la communication, avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques

  • Anglais courant

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.

Backed by over $170M in funding (Series C), we are scaling rapidly across product, engineering, and go-to-market. AI is not a bolt-on feature at 9fin; it is the core differentiator for the next phase of the company.

You will join an established AI PM team and take ownership of a product area within our AI surface. This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains. The team has already built evaluation infrastructure and quality frameworks; you will use and contribute to these rather than build them from scratch.

You will work within our product organization (eight squads across AI, data, and domain verticals) and partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and designers. This is a high-autonomy role with real scope to shape what 9fin's AI products can do for our clients.

 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for your area, with a focus on building and evolving our AI products

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into problem statements that identify root causes, not just symptoms

  • Shape the next generation of agentic AI products: multi-step reasoning workflows, tool orchestration, and autonomous task completion for financial professionals

  • Demonstrate a working understanding of the challenges specific to building with LLMs, including managing hallucinations, evaluating output quality, and designing for non-deterministic systems

  • Use confidence-building methods (prototypes, user research, data analysis) to understand how users will interact with AI-powered products before committing to full builds

AI Quality & Data

  • Use the team's AI evaluation framework (LLM-as-judge protocols, quality thresholds, SME eval cycles) to validate and improve the products you ship

  • Contribute to the data strategy for your product area: annotation quality, ground truth curation, and feedback loops that improve model performance over time

  • Proactively identify and track metrics that measure client and business benefit, working with the team on continuous model evaluation and improvement

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work

  • Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

  • Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

  • Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

  • Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring, and compliance with client expectations around AI-generated content

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in FinTech or B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years focused on ML or GenAI products

  • Working knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation methods (not just "AI concepts" at a high level)

  • Experience shipping AI products where output quality is probabilistic: you know how to define "good enough" and iterate from there

  • Comfortable reading Python notebooks and SQL to interrogate model outputs and usage data

  • Track record of shipping AI products where you managed the tension between ML research/exploration and production delivery constraints

  • Collaborative leadership style with strong stakeholder management; you build relationships that empower your team to achieve outcomes

  • User-centric communication skills: you can explain AI capabilities and limitations to clients and internal stakeholders without overselling or underselling

  • You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are energised by the challenge of building something new

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, legal tech, or data/analytics platforms

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or regulatory/compliance workflows

  • Experience with NLP applied to document analysis (contracts, legal filings, financial reports)

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, tool use patterns, or multi-step AI workflows


The Opportunity

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from in-house legal subject matter experts (SMEs), customer interviews, customer feedback and data signals to craft a clear problem statement, articulating the root cause in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

  • Impact driven: Align the team around a key outcome and effectively prioritise initiatives across multiple dimensions.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics to measure client and business benefit. Work with the team to define and manage a process for continuous model evaluation and improvement, with particular attention to the accuracy and reliability standards required in legal contexts.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team success: Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complex legal and financial concepts to technical audiences, and similarly communicate technical capabilities to legal and credit professionals.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower the squad to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside of your team.

  • Stakeholder management: Work closely with stakeholders, including 9fin's legal analysts, credit team to gather the right input and insights. You will need to listen carefully and bring people on a journey.

AI Product Development

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered legal document extraction and covenant analysis, ensuring outputs meet the precision standards required for professional use.

  • Partner with software and AI engineering to define evaluation frameworks for AI outputs in legal contexts, where accuracy, source attribution, and explainability are critical to user trust.

  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to novel legal workflow problems, from covenant compliance monitoring to cross-document analysis across deal histories.

About You

This role will be a great fit if:

  • You have a legal or financial markets background, or have built products for this audience. You may have started your career as a lawyer, paralegal, or credit analyst, or you may have been a PM at a legal tech company. You are able to hold a substantive conversation about credit agreements, covenant packages, and how legal language governs capital structures. A sharp PM from an adjacent domain who can demonstrate rapid domain immersion will also be considered.

  • You are a strategic thinker who thrives with a blank page. You are comfortable defining strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing roadmap. You can synthesise ambiguous inputs into a clear direction and bring a team with you.

  • You're a collaborative leader. You have an empathetic leadership style and build strong, effective relationships. You love working autonomously but are able to earn the trust of others with a collaborative style. You are great at prioritising, not afraid to say no, and excel at managing stakeholders while also being confident in voicing your own opinions and challenging others.

  • You've got hands-on experience with AI. You have experience with or a working knowledge of AI and LLMs, including how to evaluate model outputs in production environments. You understand what good looks like when AI is applied to high-stakes, precision-dependent workflows, and you can engage meaningfully with engineering teams on evaluation design and quality standards.

  • You work in an AI-native way. You use generative AI tools as a natural part of how you work: prototyping ideas, conducting research, reviewing PRDs, and building agents or automated workflows to extend your own productivity. You are comfortable using coding assistants to get things done faster and are genuinely excited about what this shift means for how product work gets done. This is not a nice-to-have. We expect our PMs to be at the frontier of how AI accelerates product development.

  • You thrive building from zero. You are energised by the opportunity to define something new rather than optimise something established. You move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct based on evidence.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

jobs.title: Product Owner – B2B SaaS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns

CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende.

Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern.

Deine Rolle

Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform.

Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success.

Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge.

Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten.

Deine Aufgaben

Backlog und Tickets

  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen.

  • Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen.

  • Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können.

Konzeption

  • Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt.

  • Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden.

  • Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko.

  • Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen.

Planung und Steuerung

  • Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines.

  • Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter.

  • Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person.

Schnittstellen

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität.

  • Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt.

  • Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet.

  • Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene.

  • Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing.

Deine ersten Monate

  • In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt.

  • Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht.

  • Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings.

  • Du schreibst Tickets, die Entwickler:innen gerne umsetzen: klar, vollständig, mit sauberen Akzeptanzkriterien.

  • Genug technisches Verständnis, um Aufwände und Lösungsvorschläge zu hinterfragen, gerne mit Erfahrung in Web- und Mobile-Produkten.

  • Erfahrung mit Ticketingsystemen wie GitHub Projects, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise in einem Remote-Team und klare Kommunikation zwischen Tech und Business.

  • Qualitätsanspruch: Du nimmst lieber früh Scope raus, als kurzfristig ein Release verschieben zu müssen.

  • Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, zum Beispiel für Ticket-Entwürfe, Analysen und Dokumentation.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, unsere technische Dokumentation ist auf Englisch.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit mit Impact: ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt, das Menschen schützt

  • Echte Verantwortung: du gestaltest die Produktarbeit bei uns von Grund auf

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: remote, hybrid oder in unserem Office in Berlin-Kreuzberg

  • Faires Gesamtpaket: marktgerechtes Gehalt plus erfolgsabhängiger Bonus

  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr

  • Steuerfreie Benefits wie Essenszuschuss und Gutscheine

  • Flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Offene und authentische Unternehmenskultur, geprägt durch Vertrauen, Respekt und Teamarbeit

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlerngespräch, etwa 30 Minuten

  2. Fachgespräch, etwa 60 Minuten

  3. Kleine Fallstudie, etwa zwei bis drei Stunden, die du uns anschließend vorstellst

  4. Gespräch mit beiden Gründer:innen

Nach jedem Schritt bekommst du zügig Rückmeldung von uns.

Hast du Lust, die Arbeitssicherheit mit uns auf das nächste Level zu bringen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core
jobs.description:
At Channable, we're building the future of eCommerce automation - and at the core of that vision is a world-class engineering organization. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Core Group, where you'll play a key role in integrating eCommerce channels.

🚀 About the role:

As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Core domain, you will lead an engineering department consisting of 3 team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~11 individual contributors.

You’ll be responsible for delivering maximum impact in the Core domain. You will partner up with an experienced Product Lead, with whom you will define and carry out a department vision, strategy, and roadmap. Engaged team leads and individual contributors are top of mind for you. You can learn more about the Core domain and its scope here.

🛠 What you’ll do:

  • Drive the Core roadmap by balancing the overall Channable strategy and the Core's specific opportunities

  • Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance

  • Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Improve and optimize processes that hamper productivity and can be more lean

  • Build a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement

  • You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account


💡 What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers

  • You have demonstrable experience in improving individual and team performance, as well as engagement

  • You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made

  • Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders

  • A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week

  • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week

  • You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands

Note: the official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager.

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Vous rejoignez l'équipe Produit pour piloter la réalisation de solutions innovantes, afin de faciliter la vie des opérateurs de réseaux de transport public. De la découverte des besoins terrain jusqu'au suivi des livraisons avec l'équipe technique, vous êtes le fil conducteur entre les utilisateurs, le business et les développeurs.

Votre profil a une double casquette : Product Manager, et spécialiste Design de l'équipe. Vous consacrez entre 30 et 50 % de votre temps à guider l’évolution de l'expérience utilisateur de nos applications : vous encadrez la vie de notre design system, vous veillez à la cohérence et à la qualité de nos interfaces, et vous accompagnez l’évolution des parcours utilisateurs de nos applications.
