Nos processus de conception, de design produit, de spécification et de développement sont en cours de transformation profonde, portée par l'intégration de l'IA, aujourd'hui principalement Claude. Cette évolution a déjà permis d'accélérer significativement notre vélocité sur plusieurs dimensions. Nous disposons d'un design system solide et de skills Claude qui permettent à l'équipe de produire des interfaces cohérentes, mais ils demandent à être maintenus, enrichis et challengés par une vraie expertise design. Vous rejoignez une équipe qui expérimente activement ces nouveaux modes de travail et qui attend de ses membres qu'ils s'en emparent avec curiosité et pragmatisme.

Vos Responsabilités

Product Management

  • Aller à la rencontre des clients et utilisateurs pour comprendre leurs problématiques en profondeur. Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration au-delà des demandes explicites.

  • Prendre en charge le cycle de vie de plusieurs initiatives produit en parallèle, de l’étude de la stratégie de commercialisation et la phase de discovery, jusqu'à la mise sur le marché

  • Arbitrer les priorités avec le reste de l’équipe, en cohérence avec la stratégie de PYSAE

  • Être l'interlocuteur produit de référence sur son périmètre pour les parties prenantes internes et externes

Design & expérience utilisateur (30 à 50 % du poste)

  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre design system (composants, principes, documentation) pour garantir la cohérence entre toutes nos applications

  • Faire vivre et améliorer les skills Claude de design, en lien avec l'équipe, pour que PM et développeurs front produisent des interfaces de qualité en autonomie

  • Concevoir les parcours et workflows utilisateurs des nouvelles applications et des refontes, avec une attention particulière à l'ergonomie

  • Relire et challenger les interfaces produites par l'équipe, en veillant à la cohérence et à l'exigence de qualité

  • Lorsque le temps le permet, mener des études UX avec des utilisateurs (entretiens, tests d'usage, observation terrain)

Votre Profil

  • Anglais courant ; l'italien est un plus.

  • 4 à 8 ans d'expérience cumulée dans un rôle produit et/ou design. Le profil et la motivation comptent plus que les années.

  • Sensibilité forte à l'ergonomie, aux workflows utilisateurs et à la qualité et la maintenabilité des interfaces, avec idéalement des réalisations concrètes à partager (design system, refonte d'application, parcours complexes...)

  • À l'aise dans un environnement SaaS B2B, avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux techniques sans nécessairement coder

  • Expérience sur des lancements de produit ou des refontes significatives, idéalement dans un contexte de forte croissance

  • À l'aise pour aller chercher l'information directement sur le terrain, chez les clients ; une pratique de la recherche utilisateur est un plus

  • Autonome dans l'organisation, rigoureux(se) dans le suivi, capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle sans perdre le cap

  • Adaptable : vous savez faire évoluer vos priorités sans vous déstabiliser. Dans une structure agile où les rôles ne sont pas figés, vous contribuez volontiers au-delà de votre périmètre (événements, réponses à appel d'offres, dossiers de financement innovation)

  • Curieux(se), pédagogue, bon(ne) communicant(e) avec des interlocuteurs aussi bien techniques que métier

  • À l'aise avec l'IA comme outil de travail quotidien : ouvert(e) à expérimenter de nouvelles pratiques assistées par IA (conception, design, specs, recherche utilisateur...) ; une expérience antérieure avec ces outils est un plus

Do you enjoy helping engineering teams grow while keeping a close eye on technical quality? Are you a servant leader who leads through influence rather than authority? Then you could be the Engineering Lead we're looking for.

As Engineering Lead, you'll lead and coach three back-office engineering teams in our connectivity domain. Each team has about three developers, plus outsourced developers. You'll make sure the teams deliver predictably and to a high technical standard, that people keep growing, and that the work stays aligned with product goals. You'll be part of a group of six Engineering Leads, working together on team effectiveness, technical improvements and tech alignment across teams.

Location: Sunweb Group office in Rotterdam (Hybrid)
Start Date: Asap

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead, coach and develop three engineering teams, and build high-performing teams with a growth and blameless mindset

  • Ensure predictable delivery while balancing speed with sustainable engineering practices

  • Drive technical improvements and engineering excellence, and promote software best practices

  • Simplify complex technical solutions and help teams make sound technical decisions

  • Guide teams through change and build a culture of continuous improvement

  • Align multiple stakeholders across business and technology, and drive tech alignment on cross-team initiatives

  • Work with external technology partners and suppliers when needed

Who you'll work with

You'll work closely with other Engineering Leads, Software Engineers, Architects and Product Owners. You'll also work with technicall stakeholders from Hotels, Transport, Ancillaries and Purchasing.

Who you are

You're a servant leader with strong people skills, technical curiosity and high quality standards, and you take a pragmatic approach. You work independently, take ownership and stay resilient when you meet resistance. You hold teams accountable, balance business and technical needs, and are always looking for the next step to improve.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Fluency in English

  • Dutch and/or Spanish is a big plus

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams, and you're comfortable managing several teams at once

  • Experience working with cross-functional product teams and with Product and Architecture stakeholders

  • Strong skills in people leadership, coaching, stakeholder management and Agile delivery

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, plus experience with change management

  • A lean approach to problem solving and decision making

  • Solid technical knowledge of:

    • Software engineering and modern cloud-native architectures

    • CI/CD, DevOps and software delivery practices

    • Software quality, observability, security and operational excellence

    • AI-assisted development tools that improve engineering productivity

    • Lean software craftsmanship and continuous improvement

Your toolbox

Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, observability and monitoring platforms, and collaboration and documentation tools.

Not ticking every box? At Sunweb Group, we believe curiosity, energy, and the right mindset matter more than meeting every single requirement. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear your story — let’s explore the journey together.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Yearly gross salary between 77K and 95K plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft Learn and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.  

Ready for departure? 

Do you want to become part of our team as Engineering Lead? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 7 November

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager (Product Development)
jobs.description:
About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality.

Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute.

About the role: 

You will oversee key technical initiatives to deliver our unified hardware and software platform. You will play a crucial role in transitioning products from initial development into commercial production. Taking full ownership of execution, you will bridge technology delivery with strategic commercial goals.

Key responsibilities: 

  • Own the cross-functional execution framework for complex silicon and software development programs from early architecture through tapeout, post-silicon bring-up, and release.

  • Partner closely with hardware, software, architecture, and product teams to drive alignment on milestones, roadmaps, and execution reviews.

  • Establish scalable execution practices, manage program dependencies, and proactively mitigate risks across hardware and software integration efforts.

  • Manage cross-functional dependencies and program delivery flow to ensure seamless execution.

  • Drive regular program-level product demonstrations to validate milestones and gather stakeholder feedback.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives to refine operational processes and team coordination.

  • Proactively identify and resolve architectural or organizational blockers, managing risk and maintaining relentless progress from initial exploration to customer acceptance.

  • Identify execution risks, lead risk mitigation plans, and drive trade-off decisions across scope, schedule, resources, and quality

About the team: 

This role is part of the operations team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in System & Product and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success.


  • About who you are:

    • Masters or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or a related technical field. Ability to understand the system and the sub-systems.

    • Strong technical foundation in hardware design, memory architecture, advanced packaging, chiplets, and AI acceleration technologies.

    • Proven track record in technical program management within the semiconductor industry, with experience delivering complex products that integrate novel hardware with firmware.

    • Data-driven; actively leveraging AI tools in daily workflows. 

    • Relentless Improvement Mindset.

    • Adaptive and servant leadership style and problem-solving fluency in a cross-functional organization working on complex hardware-software integration.

    • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities.

Location: Leuven (Belgium) / Grenoble (France) / Remote. Regular travel is expected to support effective and efficient collaboration and keep pace with our rapid growth.

jobs.title: Haskell Software Engineer - Creatives Team
jobs.description:
What’s in it for you (to start with):

  • Gross monthly salary ranging from € 4.000 to € 5.700 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with your May salary

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description!


Your challenges:

The Creatives team works on and is responsible for our Image Editor and related image-processing features.
You will be working on the backend and sometimes a little bit on the frontend of a complex distributed web application. Our tool provides several different services, written in Haskell, Python, and Rust.

In this position, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of new and old image-related features in our application. An important aspect of our work is scaling our services to the next level, so we can handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput while keeping our app fast and responsive. To give you a sense of scale: a couple hundred millions of images are inspected, transformed and created by our services every day.

  • Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team

  • Design, develop, and test new product features

  • Collaborate with and review PRs of other team members

  • Improve the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Work on scalability and performance improvements

  • Collaborate with our other product and platform teams to integrate image-manipulating features with other parts of our tool.

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.

Who are you?

  • You have good programming skills in Haskell (or a similar typed functional language)

  • You are familiar with other programming languages and polyglot programming: we regularly need to make modifications in services written in other languages (especially Python and Rust) as well

  • You have approximately 4-5 years of professional software engineering experience 

  • You have experience in tuning and scaling a big application

  • You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, preferably Postgres

  • Good working knowledge of Linux, git, and the command line.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Haskell libraries like warp, conduit, async, servant, aeson, effectful

  • Knowledge of Rust and its ecosystem

  • Prior experience in image processing

  • Some knowledge of TypeScript/React, which we use in our WYSIWYG Image Editor

  • A passion to provide value to customers and figuring out the 'question behind the question'.

Practical requirements:

  • EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands

  • Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office.

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.


The team:

You will join the Creatives team, consisting of five more Backend engineers, two Frontend engineers, a Product Manager, and a UI/UX designer. 

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

More benefits: 

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets.

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: senior employees can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner)  will get in touch with you for an introductory call (25 minutes)

  2. Then you are going to have a tech interview with the team members (1h)

  3. For senior candidates, we schedule a system design as well (1h)

  4. After that, we will schedule a culture and role fit interview with the Creative Team Lead and one more colleague (1h)

When we don’t have enough information, we might ask you to work on a short assignment before your tech interview.
Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.


Important note: We know that in the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the first screening,  so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact from job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 to Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in diverse and inclusive teams

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner Clinical Registries
jobs.description:
Our mission

We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients’ and clinicians’ experience.

Our mission

We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience.

Your impact

Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them.

You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible.

What you'll own

  • Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality.

  • Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets.

  • One backlog, two types of developers: you lead the product work of a team that combines data engineers with back-end and front-end developers. You translate user and partner’s needs into work for both, and you see early where a front-end change depends on a pipeline change.

  • Prioritisation within fixed capacity: you align with one counterpart at our largest registry partner on what gets built and when, with transparent trade-offs, realistic yearly planning and a clear path to extra capacity when it is funded.

  • Reusable by design: you turn partner-specific needs into shared LOGEX components wherever possible, in close collaboration with other Product Owners and Product Managers.

  • Regulatory and standards readiness: you make sure the products keep meeting healthcare regulation and move along with open data standards, e.g. FHIR.

  • Run and improve: you balance new development with maintenance and technical debt, and you help to reduce key-person risk in a small team.

  • Customer-facing: you work closely with the Customer Office on scope, project proposals and delivery expectations, and you represent the products in partner and user sessions.


What you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience as product owner or product manager

  • Proven experience with healthcare analytics or healthcare data: you understand how clinical, operational or registry data becomes insight

  • Experience working with a team of mixed engineering profiles

  • Experience managing a demanding, influential stakeholder or key client

  • Commercial awareness: you understand the difference between paid and internal work, and what it means for team capacity

  • Knowledge of clinical registries or research data is a strong plus

  • Fluent in Dutch and English, spoken and written

Why LOGEX?

  • An excellent compensation package (salary, holiday allowance, NS Business Card, phone and internet allowance)

  • 25 vacation days (based on full-time employment) to recharge, with the option to purchase additional days

  • An informal working environment with motivated colleagues

  • The possibility to work in a hybrid setup

  • A laptop and everything you need to set up a comfortable and ergonomic home office

  • Personal and professional development opportunities through our LOGEX Academy

  • Access to our mental health partner, OpenUp

  • Regular after-work drinks and many more social events

questions, you can contact Wesley Schreuder at

jobs.title: Product Owner Core Systems
jobs.description:
Over Veloretti

Veloretti is een design-led lifestylemerk uit Amsterdam, ontstaan vanuit een heldere visie op hoe mensen zich door de stad bewegen. We ontwerpen fietsen en e-bikes die passen bij het moderne stadsleven: functioneel, doordacht en met veel aandacht voor design, detail en gebruik. Het product staat centraal, maar het merk gaat verder dan mobiliteit alleen. Veloretti beweegt zich op het snijvlak van design, lifestyle en stedelijke cultuur.

Sinds 2022 horen we bij Pon.Bike. Met het oog op onze groei bouwen we aan de teams en cultuur voor de volgende fase van Veloretti.

De rol

Als Product Owner Core Systems ben je verantwoordelijk voor de belangrijkste business- en operations-applicaties zoals het ERP-systeem en het Dealer Portal. Je combineert in deze functie de strategische doorontwikkeling met het dagelijkse management van de applicaties. Dankzij je hands-on ervaring in de applicaties en je goede analytische vaardigheden vertaal je de business behoefte naar goede oplossingen die onze externe development partners kunnen realiseren.

Wat je doet

  • Beheer en prioriteer de backlog: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de backlog van het ERP-systeem, het Dealer Portal en aangrenzende integraties en applicaties. Je vindt daarbij de balans tussen business value, technische haalbaarheid, effort en toekomstvastheid.

  • Vertaal businessbehoeften naar oplossingen: Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders en vertaalt functionele wensen naar een goed solution design en user stories. Je adviseert bovendien over verbeteringen in processen en IT-architectuur.

  • Operationeel applicatiebeheer: Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor het dagelijks beheer van de toegewezen core applicaties. Je faciliteert de operatie door processen optimaal te configureren, gebruikersomgevingen te beheren en applicatie-issues effectief op te lossen.

  • Stuur externe ontwikkelpartners aan: Je leidt de samenwerking met onze IT-leveranciers om met het beschikbare budget de backlog zo efficiënt mogelijk te prioriteren

  • Werk projectmatig en gestructureerd: Je analyseert de operationele- en business processen van je interne klant, brengt risico's in kaart en plant zorgvuldig om de voortgang en afhankelijkheden te coördineren.


Wie we zoeken

We zoeken een analytisch sterke professional die zich net zo comfortabel voelt bij strategische procesarchitectuur als bij hands-on systeemconfiguratie. Je bezit de rust en het overzicht om complexe IT-vraagstukken te doorgronden, die goed uitgewerkt bij de externe development teams te beleggen en hebt de daadkracht om oplossingen zelfstandig te implementeren. Je bent communicatief sterk en daagt de business constructief uit om tot een goede oplossing te komen.

Wat je meebrengt

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner, Business Analyst of Applicatiemanager, bij voorkeur binnen een e-commerce of multichannel consumentenmerk.

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau met een sterk ontwikkeld analytisch vermogen.

  • Ervaring met ERP-systemen en de bijbehorende processen en integraties; kennis van Odoo is een sterke pré.

  • Ervaring met het runnen van e-commerce backend-platformen, specifiek gericht op de inrichting en configuratie van processen.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en/of Engels.

  • Ervaring met agile werken of relevante projectmanagement-certificeringen zijn een pré.

Wat we bieden

Een rol met impact binnen een internationaal team dat bouwt aan de volgende fase van het merk.

En verder, concreet:

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
Product Manager
jobs.description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

 

About the role

As a Product Manager at Scarlet, you will own a meaningful product area end to end. You will develop a deep understanding of the people and problems within it, set a clear direction, decide what matters most, and work with product design and engineering to deliver measurable improvements.

You will sit close to regulatory experts, account managers and customers in our London office. Their expertise will give you rich signals, but not a ready-made roadmap. Your job is to turn those signals into a coherent product strategy, make trade-offs openly and ensure what we build improves both the quality and speed of certification.

You will have substantial autonomy. We will trust you to form a point of view, test it against evidence and change course when the evidence changes.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a product area, from discovery and definition through launch, adoption and iteration.

  • Partner closely with product design, engineering and regulatory experts to turn complex requirements into clear, trustworthy workflows.

  • Spend time with customers and internal users to understand their work, observe friction and distinguish underlying problems from requested features.

  • Prioritise across customer value, regulatory rigour, operational efficiency, technical constraints and Scarlet’s company goals.

  • Keep the team aligned on the problem, the intended outcome and the trade-offs behind each decision.

  • Communicate product direction, decisions, progress and learning clearly across Scarlet.

  • Help improve how Scarlet practises product management as the team grows.

 

Required qualifications

  • Evidence of owning and shipping complex products from discovery through delivery and iteration.

  • Strong product judgement, including examples of difficult prioritisation choices made under real constraints.

  • Enough technical fluency to work effectively with engineers on systems, data, APIs and the trade-offs of AI-enabled products.

  • Clear, precise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex decisions to different audiences.

  • Comfort working in ambiguity, taking responsibility and updating your view when new evidence appears.

  • High standards for product quality, reliability and trust.

 

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in health technology, enterprise software, vertical SaaS or another regulated industry.

  • Experience building products for complex, multi-stakeholder or expert-led workflows.

  • Experience with AI-enabled products, including evaluation, failure modes and appropriate guardrails.

  • Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company where product practices were still being formed.

 

Interview process

We typically collapse steps 3 to 5 into one in-person session.

  1. Intro chat with Johnny - 30 minutes

  2. Engineering and design chats with Niclas and Jono - 30 minutes each

  3. Problem solving session with a member of tech ops - 30 minutes

  4. Interview with Johnny - 30 minutes

  5. Culture interviews with the founders Jamie and James - 30 minutes each

  6. References and offer.

 

Application note

You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. We are interested in the quality of your judgement, the outcomes you have helped create and the way you learn. If this role excites you and your experience has taken a different route, we would still like to hear from you.

Compensation: £70K – £100K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager – Firefox Enterprise
Studio Director
Team Lead Data Science & Machine Learning (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. The machine learning here is physics-based: supervised models on measurement data, inverse problems, image reconstruction. It is not a generative AI role.

We are looking for a Team Lead to take over this team of currently eight data scientists and machine learning engineers plus interns, with a clear growth perspective, from our Head of Pre-Development, who has led it directly until now. You lead the people, own the backlog as product owner in our Scrum setup, and are accountable for a production ML pipeline that chipmakers rely on, with protected time for the research that becomes the next generation of the QDm. You work alongside two peer team leads in Pre-Development.

This is a leadership role with a strong technical spine, not a principal engineer role with a few reports.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Lead and grow the team: hire, develop and keep its data scientists and ML engineers delivering together.

  • Own the backlog as product owner in our Scrum setup: prioritize production reliability against research, aligned with Applications and the two other product owners in Pre-Development and the company roadmap.

  • Own the production ML pipeline for 3D current reconstruction end to end, from training data to release, and set the engineering standards it needs: CI/CD, reproducibility, testing, and how the team uses AI coding agents.

  • Own the data science side as well: the evaluation that turns raw sensor data into field maps, the validation that says whether a map can be trusted, the FEM simulations behind the models, and the measurement algorithms for the next platform generation.

  • Pathfind our data strategy with the Head of Pre-Development, who owns it: how measurement sessions, labels and failure-analysis knowledge get captured and used.

 

What is expected of you

  • 8+ years of professional experience in data science or machine learning outside academia, at least 3 of them leading a technical team with people responsibility.

  • A senior or principal-level technical track record before leadership: you still read code and can tell a sound model validation from a flattering one.

  • Product owner experience in Scrum or a comparable framework.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

jobs.description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.

What you’ll do:

  • Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

  • Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

  • Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

  • Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

  • Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

  • Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

  • Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

What we look for

  • Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

  • Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

  • Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

jobs.title: Tester en Test Automatiseerder | Randstad
jobs.description:
Wil jij als Software Tester verder kijken dan alleen het uitvoeren van testcases? Bij ITIS Projects kom je vast in dienst en werk je aan verschillende softwareprojecten bij professionele organisaties in de Randstad. Je krijgt de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen in testautomatisering, API-testing en QA, terwijl je de zekerheid houdt van één vaste werkgever.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Tester zorg jij ervoor dat nieuwe en bestaande software doet wat gebruikers ervan verwachten. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige testproces: van het bepalen van risico's en opstellen van testscenario's tot het uitvoeren van testen, analyseren van bevindingen en adviseren over kwaliteit.

Afhankelijk van de opdracht werk je aan verschillende applicaties, systemen en technische omgevingen. Daarbij ligt de nadruk niet alleen op handmatig testen. Je krijgt juist de mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen in testautomatisering en QA.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Opstellen en uitvoeren van testscenario's en testplannen.

  • Uitvoeren van functionele, regressie- en integratietesten.

  • Analyseren, registreren en opvolgen van bevindingen.

  • Toepassen van risicogebaseerd testen.

  • Automatiseren en onderhouden van regressietesten.

  • Testen van API's en koppelingen.

  • Werken met onder andere Selenium, Postman of SoapUI.

  • Ondersteunen en begeleiden van gebruikers bij acceptatietesten.

  • Samenwerken met developers, analisten, Product Owners en andere stakeholders.

Wat wij je bieden

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting Test Automation Engineer, Senior Tester of QA Engineer.

  • Afwisselende projecten bij professionele organisaties in de Randstad.

  • De mogelijkheid om ervaring op te doen met verschillende applicaties, technieken en testomgevingen.

  • Mogelijkheden om, afhankelijk van de opdracht, hybride te werken.

  • Personeelskortingen bij verschillende bekende winkels en merken.

Wat neem je mee?

We zoeken een tester die verder kijkt dan de vraag of een testscenario groen of rood is. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar de oorzaak van een probleem, denkt kritisch mee over kwaliteit en vindt het interessant om testen steeds slimmer en meer geautomatiseerd uit te voeren.

Je hebt:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting IT.

  • Ervaring met Selenium, Postman, SoapUI of vergelijkbare testtools.

  • Kennis van API-testing.

  • Basiskennis van JSON/XML en SQL.

  • Interesse in of ervaring met testautomatisering.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

  • Een analytische en nauwkeurige manier van werken.

Heb je vooral ervaring met functioneel testen en wil je juist de volgende stap zetten richting testautomatisering? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Waar groei je naartoe?

Binnen ITIS Projects krijg je de ruimte om je technische testkennis verder uit te bouwen. Samen kijken we welke richting bij jou past en welke opdrachten, opleidingen en certificeringen daarbij aansluiten.

Bij ITIS Projects combineer je afwisseling met zekerheid. Je komt bij ons vast in dienst en werkt vanuit die basis aan verschillende opdrachten bij professionele organisaties in de Randstad.

ITIS is onderdeel van de VDK Groep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland! Met inmiddels 185 bedrijven en 9.000 medewerkers biedt VDK de zekerheid en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van een grote organisatie, terwijl je bij ITIS werkt binnen een betrokken en ondernemende omgeving.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager III, Automotive
jobs.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

At Mapbox, Technical Program Managers (TPMs) ensure successful, on-time launches for Mapbox's key customers by turning complex needs into realized value. TPMs independently develop and execute strategies to maximize customer satisfaction, while minimizing thrash in changes to priorities and roadmap. They provide high-judgement updates to Mapbox leaders–keeping them informed on progress while handling the day-to-day operations independently.

 

What You'll Do

Mapbox is seeking a Technical Program Manager III (TPM) to lead complex, high-visibility post-sales programs for our large automotive customers. This is a high-impact role in a dynamic environment where you will work both independently and collaboratively alongside a high-performing team of TPMs to deliver successful customer launches. You will drive operational rigor within your programs, acting as a key driver of accountability and consistent, high-quality delivery across cross-functional teams within Mapbox.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex automotive customer launches and programs, serving as the main point of contact for program health, timelines, and execution

  • Be the primary interface between our key automotive customers and our internal teams, advocating for mutual success by championing the needs of our customers with internal teams (including leadership, product management, engineering, sales, technical support), and representing Mapbox to our customers

  • Define success for our customer programs, including how we measure it, and how we get there.

  • Align with Product and Engineering to translate and prioritize customer feedback into actionable insights and roadmap clarity.

  • Set and uphold a high quality bar, working with technical support, product and engineering teams to ensure effective prioritization and resolution of quality issues, and to synthesize and address overarching quality concerns.

  • Lead senior-level discussions - both internally and externally - around delivery timelines, trade-offs, scope, and business impact.

  • Provide calm and decisive program leadership during high-pressure situations with customers.

  • Provide clear & concise reporting to program key stakeholders and track and manage and report on program risks, working with customers and internal teams to mitigate and/or and escalate for resolution.

  • Lead or contribute to internal initiatives to improve internal processes across the TPM and Mapbox organizations.

  • Develop a deep knowledge of Mapbox products and services in order to steer technical discussions and build trust with our customers

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8+ years of experience leading enterprise software implementations in a highly regulated post-sales or professional services environment.

  • Demonstrated success in the automotive industry managing scope, SOW execution, change management, and high-impact customer escalations.

  • Proven ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deployments from kickoff through production launch.

  • Travel: Ability to travel to visit customers regularly up to 20%, with occasional spikes during key customer launch milestones.

  • Delivery-Oriented Leader: You are accountable for outcomes and not just coordination. You build structure in ambiguity and create operational discipline that enables predictable success.

  • Customer-Centric Operator: You proactively represent the customer internally and ensure their business objectives drive implementation priorities.

  • Effective Communicator: You engage effectively across audiences from developers to senior executives with clarity, confidence, and precision.

  • Technically Fluent: You understand cloud architectures, API/SDK integrations, and enterprise technical ecosystems deeply enough to anticipate risk and guide execution credibly.

  • Cross-Functional Influencer: You navigate matrixed organizations effectively aligning Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Executive Leadership to deliver customer outcomes.

  • Knowledge of Automotive SPICE is desirable

Core Working Hours

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: Full-time

  • Standby / On-Call: As needed with ability to travel to visit customers regularly up to 30%, with occasional spikes during key customer launch milestones.

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Updated in October 2026

Target start date: March 1, 2027

Compensation: 70,000 to 85,000 EUR yearly gross, depending on profile

Location: Either in-office in Paris (Grands Boulevards, 75002) or full remote on Paris timezone

 
 

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io.

For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow

About the role

You’ll join a small, efficient team who builds high-impact features for our users. You'll work on a wide range of topics, including AI agents, workflow automations, analytics, or payment processing. We invest significantly in AI features, and you'll play a key role in making Upflow the leading agentic software in our field.

We work at a fast pace, averaging 20 deploys to production each day, but with high quality standards, and we value pragmatism, ownership, and a growth mindset.

AI is also transforming how we work, and we're looking for someone eager to use and optimize agents to help us work more efficiently.

You can be based in our Paris office or work remotely.

What you will do

In your day-to-day, you will:

  • Architect and implement complex, high-impact product features from start-to-finish.

  • Collaborate closely with the product manager, the designer, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Ship clean, maintainable code to production daily.

  • Participate actively in technical reviews providing and receiving constructive feedback.

  • Troubleshoot and debug complex product issues.

  • Optimize application performance and ensure scalability.

  • Help improve our agentic tools and automations.

Our current stack

  • Frontend: Typescript, React, GraphQL

  • Backend: Typescript, Node.js, Express, Postgres, and Redis

  • Infra: GCP, Terraform

  • Observability: Datadog and Sentry

  • Github, Copilot, Claude Code, CircleCI

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering.

  • You have strong proficiency in Typescript, React and SQL.

  • You’re proficient at working with agentic coding assistant such as Claude Code.

  • You have strong skills in architecture, software reliability, and scalability

  • You have a product sensibility and care about UX.

  • You have good teamwork skills and enjoy providing and receiving feedback.

  • You want to work in a startup environment that values excellence, autonomy, and ownership.

  • You are fluent in English with strong communication skills.

  • You are based in Paris, or live in Paris timezone

Why join us

  • International mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • On-site or full remote: On-site job in Paris (2-3 days in office), or full remote position on Paris timezone (1 monthly visit in our Paris office).

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to contribute to the Engineering function in the AI era.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem.

Recruitment Process

1 - Screening call

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

2 - Take home assignment

It’s a coding exercise that can only be completed successfully with the help of AI. In addition to delivering working software that meets the requirements, you’ll be evaluated on your product and architectural decisions.

3 - Technical interview

In this interview, we’ll review your take-home assignment and discuss how you approach designing scalable systems and making architectural decisions.

4 - Meet the team!

You’ll also meet up with at least two other peers so you can foresee yourself as part of this team.

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

jobs.description:
EggAI · Banking transformation programme (UK) · Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks

About the Programme

EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production.

EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers.

The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems.

The Role

Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold.

The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change — so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next.

This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops.

Responsibilities

  • Reliability targets — set the SLO and error-budget framework alongside the client's existing structure, have the service owners adopt it, and commission the behavioural quality measures that do the same job for agentic workloads

  • Observability and detection — define what Tier-1 services and agentic workloads must emit, including trajectory logging; require an automated path from a firing alert to the affected services and their owners; and hold the operating teams to closing the logging gaps in what runs today

  • The incident and change path — set the runbook standard and its required coverage, extend incident classification and intervention mechanisms to agentic failure modes, and have rollback and change-failure rates measured and reported by those who own them

  • Capacity and performance — direct the headroom position through the parallel-run peak at cutover, sponsor the chaos and game-day programme for payment rails and the core ledger, and mandate that capacity modelling covers inference workloads

  • Gate evidence — own the technical content of the Operational Acceptance Report and Operational Readiness Certificate, the reliability section of each gate pack, and the reliability NFRs defended as ADRs through the client's Architecture Design Authority — written by the teams, reviewed and signed off by you

  • The operating organisation — decide how responsibilities sit between the client's teams and its managed service providers for the new platform, and lead the people concerned through that change

Expected experience

  • 10+ years in leading IT operations teams — You have operated L1, L2, and L3 support as SRE, platform reliability or infrastructure organisations, with the people and the providers reporting to you

  • Aligns operations with development, engineering and the business — has set operating goals that engineering teams and business stakeholders signed up to, and kept them focused on those goals through delivery

  • Has introduced SLOs and error budgets into an organisation that did not have them, and can build on the experienced success factors

  • Infrastructure in depth — has deep infrastructure knowledge, and what is required for smooth business operations: telemetry, redundancies, backups, etc.

  • Incident management, with post-incident reviews that led to real changes in the system and in the organisation

  • Regulated financial services, or another environment where an external body audits operational evidence.

  • Has worked through a managed service provider and can set standards they do not personally execute

  • Comfortable operating in a complex, multi-stakeholder programme where scope and ownership are still being established across parallel workstreams

Valuable, not required

  • LLM or agentic system operations: eval harnesses, drift detection, trajectory analysis, prompt and model versioning treated as change types

  • Core banking or payments exposure, particularly scheme gateway integration

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a platform architect. A separate role owns agentic platform design and build

  • Not an on-call engineer. You will not carry a client pager; out-of-hours operations are run by a third party

  • Not a service delivery manager. This is engineering judgement applied to readiness, not ITSM process administration

Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:

Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Join us to be part of a pioneering company shaping the future of AI. Together, we can make a meaningful impact. See more about our culture on mistral.ai/careers.

 
 

Role summary

The Southern Europe Enterprise Sales organization is entering a rapid scaling phase. To support this growth, we are seeking a Chief of Staff to the VP of Revenue Europe South drive organizational effectiveness, strategic planning, and execution of high-priority cross-functional initiatives across the region.

This is a strategic role offering exceptional exposure and global impact. You will work closely with the VP of of Southern Europe Enterprise Sales to structure the team, lead strategic projects, organize internal reporting, and liaise with other teams. This phase offers a unique opportunity to build a global perspective on partnership priorities while owning critical initiatives.

 
 

What You Will Do

Strategic Leadership and Planning

  • Design and implement the next-stage Southern Europe Enterprise Sales operating model to support rapid headcount growth and expansion across the region (France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, and emerging markets).

  • Own annual planning, OKR orchestration, and executive performance reviews to improve alignment and execution discipline.

  • Drive company-level programs involving Sales, Partnerships,, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations (new market entries, enterprise account launches, sales plays).

  • Lead strategic projects to leverage AI for enhancing go-to-market effectiveness.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive preparation and follow-up of executive reviews, business performance tracking, and strategic decision-making processes.

  • Structure complex problems, define execution plans, and ensure delivery against business priorities.

  • Improve the GTM operating model, processes, and organizational effectiveness to support scaling.

  • Build scalable frameworks to support GTM growth and operational efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives across the Partnership organization (Managed Service Providers, System Integrators, ISVs, …).

  • Facilitate alignment between Sales leadership and key internal stakeholders (Partnerships, Product, Finance, Marketing, etc.).

  • Serve as a point of escalation to resolve conflicts and drive decision velocity.

  • Collaborate with global teams to ensure consistency in execution across regions.

Performance and Impact

  • Track and report on executive cadence effectiveness (QBRs, planning cycles, leadership rituals).

  • Monitor strategic initiative progress and execution quality.

  • Measure stakeholder satisfaction within the GTM leadership team.

  • Improve decision velocity and clarity across the organization.

 
 

About You

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years in strategic operations, business development, GTM strategy, or consulting roles (e.g., Strategy Consultant at MBB/Tier-1/Tier-2, Business Operations, Chief of Staff, or Strategic Program Manager).

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience working closely with C-level or senior leadership, high maturity in communication, influence and prioritization. Ability to operate with high autonomy and judgement

  • Scale and ambiguity mindset: Experience in fast-growing environments or high-pressure environments. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities

  • Industry Background: Experience in high-growth SaaS, AI, deeptech, or infrastructure industries. Exposure to AI, data, infrastructure, or developer-focused products is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Dutch-speaking, customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Benelux & Nordics Account Management team. As an Enterprise Account Manager at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts. In this role you will be responsible for a portfolio of top accounts. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll-up your sleeves and work hard.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of Tier 1 Customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with your contact and key decision makers within your accounts

  • Gain a deep understanding of your customers business and be able to leverage this information to ensure that the customer maximises their usage of Perk

  • Identify growth opportunities and develop your portfolio by adding new business opportunities

  • Leverage data analytics to provide clients with regular business reviews, reports and presentations to senior stakeholders

  • Be an expert on the portfolio of Perk products in order to meet & exceed quarterly targets of Up / Cross-selling

  • Develop strong relationships with your clients that will shape their business travel programmes

  • Identify common problems within each account and develop strategies to solve issues in a timely manner whilst creating methods to ensure long term solutions

  • Act as a key contact between the internal Perk teams and the Account Management Team, to ensure product integrations during roll-outs are as smooth as possible.

  • Effectively prioritise your time in order to maximise impact in key business areas

What we’re looking for

  • Native Dutch and professional proficiency in English

  • Experience managing top tier accounts

  • Outstanding presentation & communication skills and the ability to build deep relationships

  • Great prioritisation and time management skills

  • Result oriented mindset while keeping customer satisfaction as your top priority

  • Great ability to analyse and translate data for your customers

On top of that, you will be the right candidate if you are

  • Empathetic: someone who can identify with the customer and genuinely wants to support them using an optimal problem-solving methodology

  • Honest, open and trustworthy: your peers and managers can trust you. You are a team player, don’t play political games, and care more about the team’s success than about your own career gains

  • Focused and determined: You don’t let yourself be distracted. You can focus on accomplishing big wins and never get lost in less important ideas that are floating around

  • You seek feedback early and often and are open to both give and take constructive and direct criticism

What we offer

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - In-person interview

  • Values interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.description:
Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still building those solutions yourself?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while helping shape how we use AI across the organisation.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior role. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. It doesn’t mean stepping away from the technology. You’ll still design, prototype and build.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: December/ January

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery. Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions. Design and develop agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives. Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production. Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns. Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others. Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group.
